$comment: Diagnostician output contract (unified-platform-spec.md §9.3, REQ-5). A DIAGNOSING round returns testable hypotheses whose probes are cheaper than patch+verify. Untrusted input: core (core/src/repair/hypothesis.ts) RE-validates this shape before running any probe, caps probes per hypothesis, and never lets it demand unbounded execution (REQ-5.7).

probes.description: Run cheapest-first (array order = the agent's cost ordering); core stops at the first confirming probe (REQ-5.3).

expected.description: Substring the probe's captured output must contain to CONFIRM the hypothesis (REQ-5.4).
